notes: Overview tab now shows gas and electric distance-to-empty as separate stats side by side under the odometer, instead of one combined "Range" card.
Doors/Windows/Tyres/Engine/Diagnostics cards now show the actual API error (e.g. a 403 scope/subscription issue) when Volvo can't report that resource, instead of a silent "no data".
Background is now a subtle gradient instead of flat color, in both dark and light mode.
Added a font switcher (Sans, Serif, Rounded, Mono) that changes the whole dashboard's typeface on the fly and remembers your choice.
Vehicle photos (exterior/interior) now render as actual pictures on the Updates tab instead of a raw JSON dump.
Fuel tab layout: Import from Fuelly now sits beside Fill-up history instead of stacked below it.
Fixed the Fuelly badge overflowing its card on narrow screens.
Fixed a layout bug that left a large empty gap next to the fill-up form.
Overview tab: vehicle nickname shown next to the (still obfuscated) VIN.
Controls moved up near the top; Tyres/Engine/Warnings grouped into one row; Diagnostics moved to the bottom and spans full width.
Each hero stat card and the Controls card now gets its own accent color, in both dark and light mode.
Fixed fuel CSV import silently dropping total cost — column matching is now bidirectional, currency symbols and decimal-comma formats are handled correctly.
Import result now shows exactly which CSV columns matched, to make future format mismatches easy to diagnose.
Fixed a DOM XSS hole in how that diagnostic output was rendered.
Added a Terms & Conditions page, required to publish the Volvo developer app.
Added a Fuelly MPG badge linking out to the public Fuelly car page.
Added a guided OAuth setup page (/volvo-setup) that walks through Volvo's authorization-code + PKCE flow end to end, instead of hand-building URLs.
Corrected the Volvo OAuth scope list against a real app registration, after trial and error with Volvo's "invalid_scope" errors.
Every dashboard API route now requires an access code (DASHBOARD_TOKEN) — previously anyone with the URL could view location data or send lock/unlock/climate/engine commands.
Fixed a bug where loading the Overview tab could fail token refresh due to many simultaneous API calls racing Volvo's rotating refresh token.
Added self-hosted fuel tracking: log fill-ups directly, or import history from a Fuelly CSV export (Fuelly has no public API).
Initial release: overview & controls, trip log & map, software/app updates tabs.
Dark and light mode.
Self-hosted trip logging via periodic location polling.
